title: Durvalumab Plus Chemotherapy for Advanced Biliary Tract Cancer: A Post Hoc Analysis of the TOPAZ-1 Randomized Clinical Trial.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: This post hoc analysis of the global, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 TOPAZ-1 randomized clinical trial ... Participants received intravenous durvalumab, 1500 mg, or placebo plus gemcitabine ... Median OS was 13.0 ... months for durvalumab plus GemCis and 11.4 ... months for placebo plus GemCis.
assessment_de: TOPAZ-1 randomisierter Zweiarmvergleich Durvalumab vs. Placebo; OS 13.0 vs. 11.4 Monate. Menschliche Bestätigung durch HB am 2026-11-12: Einschluss bestätigt. Zwei randomisierte Arme (Durvalumab vs. Placebo), OS als klinischer Endpunkt; Volltextprüfung für Ereigniszahlen und Zensierung.

title: The effect of cycloplegia on corneal power and diameter measured by an auto-kerato-refractometer in presbyopic patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a post-hoc analysis of a randomized clinical trial.
review_basis: Titel und Abstract; kein Volltext, kein Netzabruf
evidence_quote: post-hoc analysis of a randomized clinical trial ... either 0.5% (46 patients) or 1% tropicamide (42 patients) ... mean changes ... were - 0.01 ± 0.26 D ... in the 0.5% tropicamide group ... - 0.07 ± 0.28 D ... in the 1% tropicamide group.
